name: Editorial Photography
direction: High-quality photography with confident crops, generous negative space, and restrained treatment
implementation: Use local AVIF/WebP assets with art-directed aspect ratios
avoid: Generic stock-photo collage or inconsistent colour grading

name: Product Macro
direction: Close material details, controlled reflections, and tactile product surfaces
implementation: Combine hero macro with precise supporting diagrams
avoid: Floating product renders with no context or scale

name: Human Documentary
keywords: healthcare community education nonprofit people trust
direction: Candid, dignified real-world moments with natural light and authentic environments
implementation: Prioritise consented brand photography; avoid faces as decoration
avoid: Performative stock smiles and token diversity

name: Data as Landscape
keywords: analytics climate science data ai technical
direction: Turn real data structures into spatial lines, fields, topology, or atmospheric patterns
implementation: Generate deterministic SVG/Canvas patterns from product data
avoid: Random particle backgrounds unrelated to the product

name: Geometric System
direction: A repeatable family of geometric forms built from the product's core metaphor
implementation: Create local SVG motifs with token-driven stroke, fill, and scale
avoid: Unrelated abstract blobs on every section

name: Illustrated Explainer
keywords: education children onboarding complex workflow playful
direction: Clear custom vector scenes that explain concepts and reward discovery
implementation: Use a consistent line, shape, and character grammar

name: Cinematic Atmosphere
keywords: gaming automotive entertainment ai immersive dark
direction: Dramatic light, scale, depth, and restrained atmospheric effects
implementation: Reserve cinematic treatment for hero and one signature transition
avoid: Persistent fog, bloom, and glow that reduce legibility

name: Material Collage
keywords: fashion art music campaign culture expressive
direction: Layered cut-outs, texture, typography, and image fragments with a deliberate editorial rhythm
implementation: Use a small curated texture set and stable z-index system

name: Technical Diagram
keywords: developer tool security architecture operations engineering
direction: Precise schematics, topology, annotations, and inspectable relationships
implementation: Use SVG with accessible labels and responsive simplification
avoid: Decorative architecture diagrams that imply false system facts

name: Quiet Texture
keywords: wellness craft food heritage premium calm
direction: Subtle grain, paper, fabric, or natural material texture supporting an understated brand
implementation: Use tiny local texture assets or CSS noise at low opacity
avoid: Texture over body copy or controls

name: No-Image Typography
keywords: brutalist swiss portfolio developer campaign bold
direction: Typography, grid, rules, and colour carry the entire identity
implementation: Invest in type scale, line breaks, and responsive composition
avoid: Using no imagery as an excuse for an empty page

name: Interface-in-Context
keywords: b2b saas productivity workflow app marketing
direction: Show real product UI as part of the story rather than generic browser mockups
implementation: Use accurate product screenshots or live embedded demos
avoid: Fake screens that promise functionality the product does not have
